Class MatchManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.server.MatchManager
public class MatchManager extends Object
Central server-side coordinator for all game sessions.

MatchManager is the single shared object through which both the RMI and socket layers route every player action. It maintains the full lifecycle of a match:

  1. Login — registers a client and, if the player belonged to a persisted match, tracks them for reconnection.
  2. Lobby — tracks open lobbies and starts the game when one fills up.
  3. In-game — delegates move, draw, and skip actions to the Controller, then persists the updated state.
  4. Post-game — writes match results to the database, computes global positions, and notifies clients of the final rankings.
  5. Quit / Disconnect — cleans up all server-side states and notifies affected clients.

All methods that mutate shared state are synchronized (or synchronize on this internally) to guarantee thread safety across concurrent RMI and socket threads.

  • Method Details

    • loadSnapshotsFromDisk

      private void loadSnapshotsFromDisk()
      Loads all persisted game snapshots from the disk at startup. For each snapshot, registers the match as pending restoration and advances nextMatchId past it. Also queries the database for the last known match ID to avoid ID collisions after a restart.

    • login

      public void login(String nickname, ModelObserver client) throws InvalidUsernameException
      Registers a new client session.

      If the player's nickname matches one in a pending restoration, they are recorded as reconnected. When all players of that match have reconnected, the match is resumed via restoreGame(int, GameSnapshot).

      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname
      client - the server-side observer representing this client
      Throws:
      InvalidUsernameException - if the nickname is already in use

    • restoreGame

      private void restoreGame(int matchId, GameSnapshot snap)
      Restores a previously persisted match once all its players have reconnected.

      Rebuilds the RestoredGameManager and Controller, re-injects the game visitor into each handler, registers the game with the persistence manager, and resumes execution on a new thread.

      Parameters:
      matchId - the ID of the match to restore
      snap - the persisted snapshot to restore from

    • createGame

      public int createGame(String nickname, int numPlayers) throws InvalidTimingException
      Creates a new game lobby and assigns a match ID to it.
      Parameters:
      nickname - nickname of the player creating the lobby
      numPlayers - number of players for the new match
      Returns:
      the unique match ID assigned to the new lobby
      Throws:
      InvalidTimingException - if the player is already in a match or lobby

    • startGame

      private void startGame(Lobby lobby)
      Starts a match from a full lobby.

      Builds the player list, creates the GameManager and Controller, removes the lobby, injects the game visitor into each handler, and launches the game loop on a new thread.

      Parameters:
      lobby - the full lobby from which to start the match

      public void joinGame(String nickname, int id) throws InvalidLobbyException, InvalidTimingException

      Parameters:
      nickname - nickname of the joining player
      id - ID of the target lobby
      Throws:
      InvalidLobbyException - if no lobby with the given ID exists
      InvalidTimingException - if the player is already in a match or lobby

    • move

      public void move(String nickname, int tileId) throws InvalidMoveException, InvalidPlayerException, InvalidPhaseException, OccupiedTileException, InvalidTimingException

      tileId - ID of the target tile
      Throws:
      InvalidMoveException - if the move violates game rules
      InvalidPlayerException - if it is not this player's turn

      OccupiedTileException - if the target tile is already occupied
      InvalidTimingException - if the player is not in an active match

    • requestRanking

      public Map<String,Integer> requestRanking(String nickname) throws InvalidTimingException
      Returns the global leaderboard for the player's last match configuration.

      Queries the database for cumulative scores of all players who participated in matches with the same number of players as the requester's last match. Only available after a match has ended (postMatch must contain the player).

      Parameters:
      nickname - nickname of the requesting player
      Returns:
      map from player nickname to their cumulative score
      Throws:
      InvalidTimingException - if the player is not in the post-game state

    • quit

      public void quit(String nickname) throws InvalidTimingException
      Voluntarily removes a player from their current match, lobby, or post-game screen and notifies all affected players.

      Handles four cases: active match, pending reconnection, open lobby, and post-game. In all cases that affect other players, notifies them via ModelObserver.onQuitServer(String).

      Parameters:
      nickname - nickname of the quitting player
      Throws:
      InvalidTimingException - if the player is not in a match, lobby, or post-game

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect(String nickname)
      Handles an involuntary disconnection for the given player.

      Behaves like quit(String) but also removes the player from the clients map and does not require them to be in any particular state. Used by both the RMI health check and the socket reader thread.

      Parameters:
      nickname - nickname of the disconnected player

    • terminateMatch

      private void terminateMatch(int matchId, String nickname, String reason)
      Terminates an active match, removing all server-side states and notifying every participant except the player who caused the termination.
      Parameters:
      matchId - ID of the match to terminate
      nickname - nickname of the player who caused the termination
      reason - human-readable reason sent to the remaining players

    • onGameEnded

      private void onGameEnded(int matchId)
      Callback invoked by the GameManager when a match ends normally.

      Computes each player's ranking position, inserts match results into the database, moves players to the post-game state, and triggers the game-ending notification.

      Parameters:
      matchId - the ID of the match that just ended
